name: Project Manager - Phase 1: Foundation
description: Local-first PM app with Next.js 15 + Prisma + SQLite. Phase 1 delivers core task management.

stories.title: Project Scaffolding + Database Schema
acceptanceCriteria: package.json exists with all Phase 1 dependencies (next, react, prisma, @dnd-kit, zod, date-fns, lucide-react, next-themes, sonner)
tsconfig.json has strict mode enabled
prisma/schema.prisma defines all 17 entities with correct relationships
npx prisma migrate dev runs without errors
postcss.config.mjs references @tailwindcss/postcss (no tailwind.config.ts)
vitest.config.ts exists with jsdom environment
src/lib/db.ts exports a Prisma client singleton
src/lib/constants.ts exports status and priority enums
components.json configured for shadcn/ui

stories.title: Layout + Navigation Shell
acceptanceCriteria: src/app/layout.tsx renders Providers wrapping children
src/components/providers.tsx exports ThemeProvider + Toaster
src/app/globals.css uses Tailwind v4 @theme syntax (no tailwind.config.ts)
src/components/layout/sidebar.tsx renders workspace/project navigation
src/components/layout/app-shell.tsx combines sidebar + header + content area
src/app/(app)/layout.tsx uses AppShell for all app routes
loading.tsx files exist for today, projects/[id], workspaces routes
npm run dev starts without errors and renders the shell

stories.title: Server Actions + Data Layer
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/action-utils.ts exports ActionResult<T> type
src/hooks/use-server-action.ts exports useServerAction hook with loading/error/toast
src/lib/validators.ts exports Zod schemas for workspace, project, task
src/actions/workspace.ts has createWorkspace, updateWorkspace, deleteWorkspace returning ActionResult
src/actions/project.ts has createProject, updateProject, deleteProject returning ActionResult
src/actions/task.ts has createTask, updateTask, deleteTask, reorderTasks, archiveTask returning ActionResult
src/actions/task.ts enforces max 2-level subtask depth
src/actions/daily.ts has addToDailyPlan, removeFromDailyPlan, getDailyPlan
src/actions/activity.ts logs mutations to ActivityLog table

stories.title: Today View + Quick Add
acceptanceCriteria: src/app/(app)/today/page.tsx renders as RSC fetching today's daily plan
src/components/today/daily-tasks.tsx displays tasks from DailyPlanTask with completion derived from Task.status
src/components/today/quick-add.tsx creates a task and adds to daily plan in one action
src/components/today/daily-summary.tsx shows completed count vs total
Empty state renders when no tasks planned for today
Completing a task (status=done) reflects immediately in the summary

stories.title: Kanban Board View
acceptanceCriteria: src/app/(app)/projects/[id]/board/page.tsx renders as RSC passing tasks to KanbanBoard
src/components/board/kanban-board.tsx renders columns for each task status using @dnd-kit
src/components/board/kanban-column.tsx renders tasks in a droppable column
src/components/board/task-card.tsx shows title, priority badge, and due date
Dragging a task between columns updates task status via server action
Optimistic update: card moves immediately, reverts on server error
Empty state renders when project has no tasks

stories.title: List View
acceptanceCriteria: src/app/(app)/projects/[id]/list/page.tsx renders as RSC passing tasks to TaskTable
src/components/list/task-table.tsx displays tasks in sortable table format
Columns: title, status, priority, due date, created date
Client-side sorting by clicking column headers
Task status can be changed inline via dropdown
Empty state renders when no tasks exist

stories.title: Workspace + Project Management
acceptanceCriteria: src/app/(app)/workspaces/page.tsx lists all workspaces
src/components/workspace/workspace-dialog.tsx creates/edits workspaces
src/app/(app)/workspaces/[id]/page.tsx shows projects in workspace
src/components/project/project-dialog.tsx creates/edits projects
src/components/project/project-header.tsx shows project name with view tabs (Board/List)
Sidebar dynamically shows workspaces and their projects
Deleting a workspace shows confirmation dialog
Empty states for workspaces page and project list

stories.title: Task Create/Edit Dialog + Detail Panel
acceptanceCriteria: src/components/task/task-create-dialog.tsx opens dialog with form for new task
src/components/task/task-detail-panel.tsx opens as sheet/slide-over showing full task details
src/components/task/priority-badge.tsx renders colored badge for each priority level
src/components/task/status-select.tsx renders dropdown for status changes
Task form validates with Zod (title required, valid dates)
Creating/editing task shows success toast
src/components/shared/empty-state.tsx is reusable across views
